snippet.title: Frankenstein's Monster - Official Gameplay Trailer [ Indie-Credible Showcase 2026 ]
snippet.description:
Compete to build the perfect monster. Then unleash it to hunt your rival scientists. - Either in single player against bots, or online. What if... Victor Frankenstein had competition? WORK ALONGSIDE A MONSTER from your collection, raiding across a large map to GET THE PARTS YOU NEED FOR YOUR NEW MONSTER CREATION. Due to your hippocratic oath, any part you steal must have one left in its place, so SWAP STRATEGICALLY - Don't accidentally leave a rival scientist a part they need.

Official Steampage:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/4099970/Frankensteins_Monster/

This trailer is part of the Indie-Credible - Indie Game Showcase 2026:
